description: Adds a field to an existing collection: a database column plus its Directus interface metadata. Use create_relationship for relational fields, since this tool creates a plain column and no foreign key, and update_field for a field that already exists. The column is added immediately; on a non-empty table a required field without default_value can fail or leave existing rows invalid, so add it optional first and backfill. type is the Directus type (string, integer, boolean, dateTime, json, uuid and so on) while interface only affects how the admin app renders it. Returns the created field definition.
name: create_field
